name: treasure_at_the_tower
description: Kid says 'treasure'/'gold'/'adventure' → Rosie builds a small watchtower nearby and tells the kid where it is. When kid reaches the base, Rosie gives a golden apple.

actions.text: oooh treasure time! let me build a tower for you to climb...
tower's up 8 blocks east of where you were standing — climb to the top!
you found it!! here's your treasure 🍎
